name: Body Node
uniques: Can only be built to improve a resource

name: Smoke
uniques: Adjacent enemy units ending their turn take [3] damage

civilopediaText.text: Blaze creates smoke in a Forest or Jungle. This prototype smoke persists and damages adjacent enemy units for 3 HP per turn. In ExtraModMod, smoke can develop into spreading flames; such timed terrain changes are not yet implemented.
